questions.question: Which two questions are essential to ask during the Data Activation Cycle's Audit phase, in which you map your existing data to your marketing objectives and identify gaps?
options: What data do we need to achieve our current marketing goals?
What technology is in place today, and where does our data currently reside?
What is the ideal tech stack and data flow for our business two years from now?
How will compliance and IT teams grant specific approvals?
questions.explanation: During the Audit phase, you ask what data is needed for goals and what technology/infrastructure currently exists to identify gaps.

questions.question: A marketer is building an onboarding Canvas and wants to send a reminder about setting up direct deposit (high-value action) to new users who haven't completed it yet. What is the logical next step after the initial welcome message?
options: Attach a Decision Split filtered by direct_deposit_added event
Immediately attach an Experiment Paths component
Add a Context Variable to pull credit score data
Set Canvas Exit Criteria to trigger when user performs any custom event
questions.explanation: A Decision Split filtered by the custom event will separate users who completed the action from those who haven't, allowing targeted follow-up.
